mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT id, parent_id FROM sys_org WHERE id = #{orgId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND delete_flag = 0 UNION ALL SELECT o.id, o.parent_id FROM sys_org o INNER JOIN descendants d ON o.parent_id = d.id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.delete_flag = 0 ) SELECT id FROM descendants WHERE id != #{orgId}
